turns.speaker: scammer
turns.text: Hello, main Inspector Rajiv Verma bol raha hoon, CBI cyber crime branch se.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Ji? Kaun? Kya hua sir?

turns.speaker: scammer
turns.text: Aapke naam par ek FedEx parcel Mumbai customs mein pakda gaya hai.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Parcel? Maine toh kuch mangwaya nahi.

turns.speaker: scammer
turns.text: Us parcel mein paanch passport, ek laptop aur 200 gram MDMA drugs mile hain.

turns.speaker: scammer
turns.text: Aapke Aadhaar se ye parcel book hua hai. Ye money laundering ka case hai.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Sir main ek simple aadmi hoon, mera isse koi lena dena nahi.

turns.speaker: scammer
turns.text: Aapke khilaaf arrest warrant nikal chuka hai. Aapko abhi giraftar kiya ja sakta hai.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Sir please aisa mat kijiye, main kya karun?

turns.speaker: scammer
turns.text: Ye bahut confidential case hai. Kisi ko mat batana, na family ko na dost ko.

turns.speaker: scammer
turns.text: Aapko video call par rehna hai, call mat kaatna warna turant police aa jayegi.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Theek hai sir, main call par hoon.

turns.speaker: scammer
turns.text: Main aapko CBI verification app bhej raha hoon, app download karo.

turns.speaker: scammer
turns.text: Play store se AnyDesk download karo aur 9 digit code mujhe batao.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Sir download ho gaya, code ye hai.

turns.speaker: scammer
turns.text: Ab aapka screen share ho raha hai, main aapke bank account verify karunga.

turns.speaker: scammer
turns.text: Aapke account mein jitna paisa hai, sab RBI ki jaanch ke liye dikhana padega.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Sir mere account mein sirf bachat ke paise hain.

turns.speaker: scammer
turns.text: Koi baat nahi, nirdosh sabit hone ke liye aapko verification deposit karna hoga.

turns.speaker: scammer
turns.text: Ye paisa RBI safe account mein transfer karo, jaanch ke baad refundable hai.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Kitna paisa transfer karna hoga sir?

turns.speaker: scammer
turns.text: Rs 4,85,000 abhi transfer karo, 30 minute ke andar warna giraftari pakki hai.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Sir itna paisa mere paas nahi hai.

turns.speaker: scammer
turns.text: FD tod do, loan lo, lekin abhi transfer karo. Ye last warning hai.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Theek hai sir, main bank ja raha hoon.

turns.speaker: scammer
turns.text: Bank mein kisi ko kuch mat batana, bolna ghar ka kaam hai.

turns.speaker: scammer
turns.text: Account number likh lo: 0000 1234 5678, naam RBI Safe Account, IFSC FAKE0000001.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Ji sir, likh liya.
